College Football Season Kicks Off with Multiple Games

The college football season has begun with several teams opening their campaigns. No. 4 Notre Dame is set to play Wisconsin at Lambeau Field, aiming for a faster start to their season. No. 7 Miami is commencing their season with a cross-country trip to face Stanford. Wake Forest, led by Lopez, achieved a fast offensive start in their 38-16 season-opening victory against Akron. Baylor is beginning a critical season under coach Dave Aranda with a game against Auburn in the Big 12's game of the week. Additionally, Nebraska is starting its fourth season under Matt Rhule with a home game against Ohio.
